headline: Palmer Called Up, Then Called Off
deck: Cole Palmer, owned by test1, set to withdraw from England's Nations League squad with a minor injury.
body:
test1 lose a forward to the treatment room before he has kicked a ball for anyone. Cole Palmer, recalled by England, is set to pull out of the Nations League squad with what the wire calls a minor injury. Nothing beyond that is known.

No timeline, no return date, no word on whether he features for his club in the meantime. test1, out on their own at the top, wait for the same clarity the rest of us do.
